# Philippines

Values for an OG-Core calibration, then the estimates behind them. How to use them: [calibration guide](../calibration-guide.md).

## Values for OG-Core

| OG-Core input | Wealth gradient | Source |
|---|---|---|
| `fert_gradient` | −0.99, by age as below | DHS 2022, TFR, plus [age offsets](../methods/fertility-by-age.md) |
| `infmort_gradient` | −1.60 | DHS 2022, infant mortality rate |
| `mort_gradient` | −1.04 (95% prediction interval −1.75 to −0.33) | [general gradient](../methods/general-gradient.md) at GDP per capita (PPP, constant 2021 international $) of $10,748 (2025, World Bank) |
| `imm_pctiles` | not provided | — |

Divide each value by 100 × (1 − p) before passing it to OG-Core ([how](../calibration-guide.md#converting-a-gradient-to-og-cores-units)).

## Notes

- No census or survey with a household-deaths module is available (the country's DHS surveys have no module on deaths of household members at all ages), so adult mortality uses the general gradient (value in the table above). Fertility and infant mortality come from the 2022 NDHS.
